history.text: Portuguese navigator Pedro de Sintra named the peninsula Serra Lyoa.
Freetown was founded as a settlement for freed slaves.
The colony became a British base for suppressing the Atlantic slave trade.
Civil war, funded partly by diamonds, ended with disarmament.

worthSeeing.title: Tiwai Island:
worthSeeing.text: A river island sanctuary with one of the highest primate densities in the world.

worthSeeing.title: Bunce Island:
worthSeeing.text: A ruined slave-trading fort on the Sierra Leone River.

worthSeeing.title: Freetown Peninsula:
worthSeeing.text: Beaches such as River No. 2 below forested hills.
